prose: A user essay on why Instinct feels like a personal assistant rather than a tool. The author needed dental insurance, texted Instinct expecting a phone number, was told the question was wrong, and was enrolled 22 minutes later after nine messages and two secure forms. The piece praises its honesty about limits: in one test it withdrew a false claim that a voice memo had been delivered, saying it could only confirm 'sent'.
highlights: A first-person review of Instinct as a personal assistant
Dental insurance done in 22 minutes over nine texts
Praises it admitting uncertainty about delivery
